title: Finishing the Class Poster
story: The class had to finish a poster before the bell. Amir drew the map, and Noor wrote the labels. Their glue was dry, so the corners would not stay down. Noor borrowed a new stick from the art room. They pressed each corner and checked the spelling. The teacher smiled and hung the poster by the door. They sat down just as the bell rang.
